summary.headline: Zodiac Signs, Planetary Rulerships, and Restitutions
summary.text: Catalog of Florentine codex passages on the activity and effects of the twelve zodiac signs, their paranatellonta according to Teucer, daily and hourly rulerships of the seven planets, lunar phases, Eutocius’s astrological writings, the rising of the Dog, stellar oppositions, and the greatest years and restitutions of the planets. Cross-references cite Pappus, Valens, Teucer Babylonian, and related excerpts in Parisinus 2506.
